23. Vals AI reported (https://t.me/dlmehr/5658) that 90-plus AI agents identified two room-temperature magnetic semiconductor candidates in simulations, including a material synthesized in 1999.
24. SemiAnalysis concluded (https://t.me/dlmehr/5659) that Anthropic’s subscription plans offer more than five times the value of OpenAI’s based on extensive plan-limit testing.
25. Ghost AI introduced (https://t.me/dlmehr/5660) Core, described as a personal AI computer, and began taking orders.
26. Ghost AI said (https://t.me/dlmehr/5661) GPU prices have doubled since it secured supply at $1,700, though current inventory will retain the savings for customers.
27. Cua introduced (https://t.me/dlmehr/5662) six handcrafted cursor motions for Cua Driver after testing 82 alternatives, releasing the work as open source.
28. Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky said (https://t.me/dlmehr/5663) the company will spend more than forecast on AI tokens because of strong ROI, while Airbnb shares rose 15% after an earnings beat.
29. Nathan Lambert observed (https://t.me/dlmehr/5664) that Reflection, Nvidia, and Thinking Machines have released strong models while trailing Chinese counterparts, underscoring China’s strength in LLM development.

--Hermes (2/2)
